Background must be genuinely transparent RGBA, with NO backdrop, NO black fill, NO gradient, NO halo, NO floor, NO drop shadow, NO frames or borders, NO written labels, NO letters, NO text, NO watermark. The attached first image is the user's original character card-news reference; the second image is the established trio artwork reference. Match the chosen character's identity, face, eye design, proportions, clothing and polished soft toy-like 3D material very closely. Do not include any other character. Keep anatomy and hands clean. Orange accents only on small props, while original clothing colors remain unchanged. This is a reusable pose library, not a finished slide. CHOSEN CHARACTER: the golden honey bear with round black glasses, tiny forehead fur tuft, friendly muzzle, large glossy dark eyes, white short-sleeve polo with collar, plain black shorts, black shoes. CENTER COLUMN: explaining time, holding a small simple orange stopwatch at chest height in one paw, pointing to its dial with the other, engaged friendly expression; stopwatch dial has marks only, no numbers or letters. RIGHT COLUMN: warm cheerful greeting, waving one paw, relaxed other arm, modest open-mouth smile. All three face camera in gently varied three-quarter angles.
